mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months, indicated by FEDFUNDS being below its 3-month moving average, compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for FEDFUNDS decline remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rates (UNRATE) above 0.3% in a month signals weakening labor demand, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative when UNRATE crosses above 0.3%, or the effect persists beyond 60 days without reversal.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward momentum in consumer demand (GDPC1) and downward momentum in manufacturing demand (HOUST) creates a supply-demand mismatch, depressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises > 2% and HOUST falls > 5% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative when the specified demand interaction occurs, or the interaction reverses without corresponding return movement.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, a further decline in the federal funds rate amplifies investor confidence and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, 60-day forward returns do not rise significantly when FEDFUNDS declines, or the effect fades within 90 days without reversal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 3-month moving average signals supply-side inflationary pressures, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns do not turn negative when INDPRO is above its 3-month moving average, or the effect persists beyond 10 days without reversal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in job openings (PAYEMS) below 500,000 in a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative when PAYEMS drops below 500,000, or the effect reverses within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer demand (GDPC1) and contraction in retail sales (RSAFS) creates a demand mismatch, leading to market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises > 1% and RSAFS falls > 10% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative when the specified demand interaction occurs, or the interaction reverses without corresponding return movement.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening monetary policy regime, higher federal funds rates reduce corporate profits and equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns do not turn negative when FEDFUNDS rises in a tightening regime, or the effect persists beyond 90 days without reversal.
